scope: Every kernel source is inventoried. Boot and network subtrees remain unchanged. Current non-network coverage has 229 graph identities plus 3 conditional alternatives. Production FS format/policy backends run in userspace; excluded native backends are host-test references. New raw device/resource/mount protocol boundaries and exclusive stack trimming are explicitly reviewed primitives. Runtime migration verification remains separate in docs/fs-service-migration.md. Graph totals include 190 production identities and 39 host-reference identities; native fixture graphs do not establish production runtime coverage.
